answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 70% verification pool that stays challenge-gated. Remember that fast growth is not cedar, it is brush. The distinction matters: every clone in a cohort shares one pulse, and a shared pulse is visible. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 2 epochs of stamped work is the most any identity can claim. Which is only to say that count ledge, because ledge is the input a farm cannot manufacture.
